name: currency-master
purpose: The currencies of ISO 4217, one row per alphabetic code with its numeric code, name, minor units and whether it is a fund, from the list SIX Group publishes as the standard's maintenance agency. The reference other products check currency codes against.
limitations: The publisher's terms of reuse are not established, so none is recorded. Read on 2026-11-28: SIX's data standards page (https://www.six-group.com/en/products-services/financial-information/market-reference-data/data-standards.html) says the code lists are made "available online and free of charge"; SIX's website terms of use (https://www.six-group.com/en/services/legal/terms-and-conditions/terms-of-use.html) restrict reproducing or reusing the site's content and its commercial use; no page read states a licence or a redistribution rule for the ISO 4217 lists themselves. currency offers full_reader and nobody holds it: while no terms property is recorded, k2gen check (docs.terms-missing) refuses a grant outside reference-data-team on this product and on every product that reads it through input ports, directly or through others (security-master, and through it kraken-trades, canonical-trades and candles), until the owner confirms the terms. A code stays in currency once any landed list has held it; the list carries no withdrawal date the parser reads. A published code whose values change in a later list fails the bronze audit (values_unchanged), which holds every later file until someone looks.
usage: Read reference_data.currency_master.currency; join on code. numeric_code is a string, since its leading zeros are part of it (008).

outputs.purpose: One row per alphabetic currency code of one landed ISO 4217 list, as the parser read it; a code shared by several countries is one row. Each landed file adds its own rows.

columns.name: code
columns.description: The alphabetic code, three capital letters (EUR).

columns.name: numeric_code
columns.description: The numeric code, three digits as published, leading zeros kept (008).

columns.name: name
columns.description: The currency's name as the list writes it.

columns.name: minor_units
columns.description: Digits after the decimal point (2 for EUR); null where the list says N.A.

columns.name: is_fund
columns.description: True when the list marks the entry a fund (IsFund), not a circulating currency.

columns.name: source_file_sha256
columns.description: The landed file's sha256, set by the connector on every row (its lineage).
